errors.evidence: This is incorrect. While three series are indexed to 100 in 2015, the legend explicitly states that two other series ('HVPI (Index, Oktober 2022 = 141,2)' and 'Bruttostundenlöhne und -gehälter, VGR (Index, 4. Quartal 2022 = 141,2)') are indexed to a value of 141.2 in late 2022.
The x-axis ticks are labeled for January and July of each year, which represents half-year (semi-annual) intervals, not quarterly intervals.
The x-axis is not labeled for every quarter. It is labeled for January and July of each year.
